title: fatal: not a git repository
errorText: fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git
causes: You are in the wrong directory.
The project was never initialized with Git.

steps.text: Move into the project folder, or create a repository here.

title: Permission denied (publickey)
causes: The server or GitHub does not have your public key.
SSH is offering a different key than the one you registered.
Wrong username or file permissions on the server.

steps.text: On the server, ~/.ssh should be mode 700 and authorized_keys 600.

title: Error: listen EADDRINUSE
errorText: Error: listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use :::3000
causes: Another process, possibly an old copy of your server, already uses that port.

steps.text: Stop it politely, using the PID from the output.
Or run your app on another port.

title: npm EACCES permission denied
causes: Global npm directory owned by root.

steps.text: Do not use sudo npm. Install dependencies locally in your project.
If node_modules was created by root, check ownership.
Consider a Node version manager for global installs.

title: error: externally-managed-environment
causes: The system Python is managed by the OS package manager (PEP 668).

title: Termux: unable to locate package
causes: Stale package index or a broken mirror.
The package has a different name in Termux.
